en: A monochrome image shows an enclosed historic courtyard with two stories of buildings. The upper level has a wooden balcony with balustrades running around the courtyard and shuttered windows; the roof is steep and tiled with carved wooden supports. On the ground floor there are arched doorways, plaques, sculpted coats of arms, and reliefs set into the walls. A staircase with a wooden handrail leads up from the courtyard to the balcony beside a large pointed-arch doorway closed off by metal gates. In one corner there is a neat pile of cannonballs or stone balls. A framed inscription plaque with decorative carvings is visible on the left wall, but the text is too small to read clearly.
